- **Reference:**

    - **Year:** 2010
    - **Title:** Isothermal compression behavior of (Mg,Fe)O using neon as a pressure medium

    - **Pressure gpa:** \[15.5, 70.9\]
    - **Temperature k:** \[300, 300\]
    - **Notes:** High-spin compression branch only; the first volume collapse occurs at 72.2 GPa.; BM2 makes K0\_prime=4 part of the equation definition.
- **Volume basis:**
    - **Kind:** formula\_units
    - **Formula units:** 4
    - **Molar mass g mol:** 52.6046
- **Reported error confidence level:** Not specified

| Primary | K0 | 161 | 3 | Not listed |

Values use the source model's parameter units. Primary `V0` uses
the conventional-cell volume declared above. Errors retain their reported
meaning; an absent error is unknown, and absence of covariance does not
establish statistical independence.

This is Zhuravlev et al.'s source-owned high-spin EOS, distinct from the later Solomatova et al. coupled crossover branches fitted to the full compression trajectory. The paper states that the printed pressure uncertainties describe drift during acquisition and that the true pressure uncertainty is likely closer to 3%; exact EOS-FIT weights and covariance are not published.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

- **Description:** Complete Table S2: 77 printed observations, preserving source order and sample IDs.

- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Fei; Zhang; Corgne; Watson; Ricolleau; Meng; Prakapenka
    - **Year:** 2007
    - **Title:** Spin transition and equations of state of (Mg, Fe)O solid solutions
    - **Source:** Geophysical Research Letters
    - **Volume:** 34
    - **Locator:** L17307
    - **DOI:** 10.1029/2007GL030712

- **Associated EOS records:** mg061fe039o\_fei\_2007\_hs\_b1\_bm3; mg061fe039o\_fei\_2007\_ls\_b1\_bm3; mg061fe039o\_solomatova\_2016\_fei\_hs\_bm3\_reference\_1; mg061fe039o\_solomatova\_2016\_fei\_ls\_bm3\_reference\_2
- **Notes:** Only original lattice parameters, printed errors and pressure columns are reported observations. Volume a^3 and its first-order error 3a^2\*error(a), path assignment, and NaCl phase are curator derivations. Printed 0.0000 errors remain literal zeros (not exact measurements); missing errors remain blank. No pressure uncertainties are invented. The fp39 mw39c block is decompression (paragraph 8/Figure 2 and reversed pressure sequence); no separate decompression EOS is published. For mw58 at &gt;=44 GPa the scalar a\_mw58 does not specify a full rhombohedral cell, so volume and its error are deliberately blank. The 42.75 GPa B1 row is retained, although the caption rounds the HS fit limit to 42 GPa. Linked full tables contain observations outside the fitted branch; use record validation\_selection explicitly.
